source.title: ERCOT Large Load Interconnection Status Update, June 19 2026

notes: Status components and total are published rounded; sum may differ.
5.7 GW observed is all-time non-simultaneous peaks, not current simultaneous power.
Industry percentages are not exact category MW; do not silently multiply into source-reported MW.

June 2 Batch Zero eligibility chart total 481.4 GW is a different snapshot and scope from June 18 466.5 GW LLIS chart.
Later Batch Zero 125.4 versus 127.9 GW discrepancy not resolved in this research pass; do not replace either without source-specific as-of evidence.
